_doc: Per-agent quick replies for the GrokPod modal, keyed by agent id. match = substring that must appear in the current pending question, otherwise buttons are dropped as stale. question = optional cleaner display text. buttons: 2-4 {label, reply, snooze?}. fallback 'grokbot' = also offer 'solve it in the app'.

buttons.label: Daily
buttons.reply: Make it a daily digest, every weekday morning.

buttons.label: Weekly
buttons.reply: Make it a weekly digest, every Monday morning.

buttons.label: Snooze 1 day
buttons.reply: Snooze: remind me about this tomorrow.

buttons.label: Never mind
buttons.reply: Never mind, keep it on demand only.

demo-0009.name: Growth Bot
demo-0009.question: Should I run the next growth experiment this week?
